text: July CPI rises 0.1% monthly and 3.4% annually; core CPI rises 0.2% monthly and 2.5% annually. Energy falls 1.5% for the month while remaining 14.7% higher annually. Shelter rises 0.1%, accounting for about two-thirds of the headline monthly increase.

meta.note: Monthly and annual readings operate at different temporal layers and remain directionally distinct.
